title: The People of Medeba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are mentioned in Mikvaot, chapter 7, mishnah 1: they testified in the name of R' Yishmael. And it [Medeba] is a city in the land of Moab (Joshua 13), and it is mentioned in Isaiah 15.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ז מ״א gives 7m 1, unlike older machine 6m 1; Joshua 13/Isaiah 15 are broad supplied chapter labels, not added verse references or fresh verified locations.

Plural they refers to people testifying; feminine-singular it refers to Medeba the city, with the bracketed name clarifying that referent. Yishmael’s personal title remains R', without an identity binding.
